name: opencode-clojure
description: OpenCode plugin: auto-repair Clojure delimiter errors on write/edit/patch + in-process nREPL eval tool (self-contained: embedded parinfer, optional cljfmt)

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --allowImportingTsExtensions --target es2022 --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --skipLibCheck --types node index.ts parinfer.d.ts
